instruction: In the great pool on the height in the middle of the town, at its steps going down, on the side of the sunset, 5 cubits: [deposit].
context: Redacted site description: a town on a ridge in a basalt upland, above a ravine on its north side that is crossed by an ancient one-arched bridge. Nineteenth-century travellers describe several large stone-lined pools in and near the town; their notes are brief and sometimes disagree.

position.relative_to: town centre (north, by the ravine and the road from the bridge)

features.notes: Walls half fallen; 'more like a pond'. Two travellers mention a pool here; they may describe one pool or two.

features.opening: flights of steps down to the water
features.dimensions: circular, about 90-100 m across; 9-15 m deep (reports differ)
features.notes: Lined with squared stones; the main houses of the present village stand around it. Women fetch water by narrow stone steps.

position.relative_to: town centre (north side, near the government house)

features.dimensions: larger circumference than the central pool but shallower; one traveller gives about 600 paces round
features.notes: Better preserved than the others; one traveller places a 'lake' of this size on the north-west of the town. Once a watering place for the pilgrim caravan.

withheld_question: From which direction is the chosen pool filled?
